_comment: Copy this file to playlists.json and fill in real values. One entry per playlist.

spreadsheet._comment: Column letters in the sheet tab. Status values used: empty/'ready' -> processed by the pipeline, 'uploaded' -> skipped.

imageGeneration._comment: If enabled and a row has no backgroundImage, an image is generated via the OpenAI image API and used for both the thumbnail and the video background. Requires OPENAI_API_KEY env var or config/openai.json.
imageGeneration.promptTemplate: A cinematic, atmospheric background illustration for a video titled '{title}'. {description}. No text, no logos, 16:9.

thumbnail._comment: x/y are raw ffmpeg drawtext expressions

video._comment: kenBurns: slow zoom on the background image for the main segment
